info.name: JobFit API
info.description: Sample requests for the Resume Job Matching System. Run Step 1 first, copy the returned 'id', and paste into Step 2.

request.description: Verify the Python similarity microservice is running.
Step 1: Upload a resume. Copy the 'id' from the response and use it in the match request.
Step 2: Match the uploaded resume against a job description. Replace resumeId with the ID from Step 1.
Retrieve a stored resume to verify it was saved correctly.
Debug: Call the Python service directly to test similarity scoring.
